newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-PALLISTER, NEVILLE OUT AS UNITED FACE VILLA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PALLISTER, NEVILLE OUT AS UNITED FACE VILLA.

text.p: Manchester United will be without key defenders Gary Pallister and Phil Neville for Wednesday's English premier league clash with Aston Villa at Old Trafford.
While Pallister's back problems have been around for some time, the news that Neville will be out for a month with glandular fever is an unexpected blow for United manager Alex Ferguson.

Even so, the defending champions, in second place five points behind Liverpool, have hit a rich vein of form recently and will be confident of taking all three points from the big match of the New Year's Day programme.

Ferguson, chasing his fourth title in five years, has certainly welcomed the return to form of his captain, Frenchman Eric Cantona, as well as the return to fitness of striker Andy Cole and Irish midfielder Roy Keane.
In sixth-placed Villa, however, they face another form side with another form striker in Dwight Yorke, who has hit 12 goals in his last 14 games.
In Wednesday's other highlight fixture, leaders Liverpool will be looking for their seventh away win of the season when they take on Ruud Gullit's seventh-placed Chelsea side at Stamford Bridge.

When the two sides met at Anfield in September, player-manager Gullit's team were given a football lesson as two strikes from Czech international Patrick Berger helped Liverpool to a thrilling 5-1 win.
Berger has since been unable to hold down a regular place and it remains to be seen whether he will start ahead of Stan Collymore.

In the other key games at the top, third-placed Arsenal will be looking to check their faltering form when they host Middlesbrough at Highbury while Wimbledon, fourth in the league, travel to Southampton for whom Matt le Tissier is again doubtful.
Fifth-placed Newcastle, buoyed by their 7-1 thrashing of Tottenham at the weekend, seek to consolidate against Leeds at St.James' Park to keep the pressure on the leaders.
